title: FrankenTerm Deferred Proof Replay Harness Decision
description: Static contract for the dry-run decision the deferred-proof replay harness records for a single queued receipt. The harness projects retained receipts into a queue, classifies each one fail-closed, and selects at most one next candidate. It never produces material remote proof: live replay still requires a real remote RCH worker (ft-zbnz4.4 -> ft-5xwsu.3).

decision.description: Authoritative dry-run classification derived from structural and coordination facts. The receipt's self-declared eligibility is untrusted input and never upgrades this decision. There is no green/proof_complete value: the harness cannot mint material proof.

selected_worker.description: Worker the original capture had already selected when a remote failure occurred. Present only for selected-worker failures so that a topology-preflight failure is never coarsened into no-admissible-workers admission.

remote_exit_status.description: Always null in the harness. A non-null remote exit status may only be recorded by a real remote RCH replay, never by this dry-run.

replay_allowed_now.description: True only when the receipt can be proven right now without any RCH worker, i.e. a static verifier. Material remote receipts are always false here because the harness refuses to mint remote proof.
